name: Ingenieur Gudang Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ingenieur Gudang Berhad 的主要业务动态集中在物业资产处置：全资子公司 Magnitude Resources Sdn Bhd 以 2,200 万令吉现金出售位于 Seremban, Negeri Sembilan 的工厂及办公楼；同时，子公司 Ingenieur EPCM Sdn Bhd 与 Keng Huat Construction Sdn Bhd 及 Paris Dynasty Land Sdn Bhd 签订三方债务和解协议。此外，公司涉及多项重大诉讼公告。
overview_en: In 2026, Ingenieur Gudang Berhad's main business developments centred on property disposal: wholly-owned subsidiary Magnitude Resources Sdn Bhd disposed of a factory with office in Seremban, Negeri Sembilan for RM22.0 million cash; meanwhile, subsidiary Ingenieur EPCM Sdn Bhd entered into a tripartite debt settlement agreement with Keng Huat Construction Sdn Bhd and Paris Dynasty Land Sdn Bhd. The company also made several material litigation announcements.

segments.name: 物业租赁
segments.note: 今年主要动态为出售一项投资物业（工厂及办公楼），并处理相关债务和解。
segments.note_en: The main development this year was the disposal of an investment property (factory with office) and the related debt settlement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述物业出售提供进一步补充资料。
actions.text_en: Provided further additional information on the above property disposal.

actions.title: Proposed disposal by Magnitude Resources Sdn Bhd, a wholly owned subsidiary of INGENIEU of a single storey detached factory with two storey
actions.text: 就上述物业出售回应 Bursa Malaysia 的询问，提供工厂楼龄及出售代价厘定基准等补充资料。
actions.text_en: Responded to Bursa Malaysia's query on the above property disposal, providing additional information including the age of the factory and the basis for determining the disposal consideration.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Magnitude Resources Sdn Bhd 与 Baba Products (M) Sdn. Bhd. 签订有条件买卖协议，以 2,200 万令吉现金出售位于 Seremban, Negeri Sembilan 的永久地契土地及单层独立工厂连两层办公楼。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Magnitude Resources Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Baba Products (M) Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 工程与安装服务
segments.note: 今年子公司签订三方债务和解协议，处理客户欠款。
segments.note_en: This year, a subsidiary entered into a tripartite debt settlement agreement to settle amounts owing from a client.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Ingenieur EPCM Sdn Bhd 与 Keng Huat Construction Sdn Bhd 及 Paris Dynasty Land Sdn Bhd 签订三方和解协议，处理 KHSB 欠 IESB 的款项及 PDLSB 欠 KHSB 的款项。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Ingenieur EPCM Sdn Bhd entered into a tripartite settlement agreement with Keng Huat Construction Sdn Bhd and Paris Dynasty Land Sdn Bhd to settle the amount owing by KHSB to IESB and the amount owing by PDLSB to KHSB.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年有多项重大诉讼公告，与具体业务板块无直接对应。
segments.note_en: There were several material litigation announcements this year that do not directly correspond to a specific business segment.
